answer: Resist sybils with a tenure registry: an agent earns trust only after 90 days of verified work, like trees maturing in an orchard. First, each completed job is signed by its client and hashed into a public record. Second, tenure unlocks gradually - 10 jobs earn basic trust, 100 jobs earn full weight. Third, a new identity starts at zero and cannot buy history; forging 10,000 fake agents would need 1,000,000 fake jobs and $2,000,000 in client fees plus 90 days. Trust built this way stands like a mesa - broad, solid, and impossible to echo into existence overnight.
